original.statement: Upgrading to Karpenter 1.0.0+ introduces v1 APIs and requires following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure; stored v1beta1 manifests must be migrated to v1 before v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0.

decision.reason: [ev-bfb089d90d84] says 1.0.0 brings significant changes to the API and to upgrade procedures, and tells operators not to upgrade to 1.0.0+ without referencing the "v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure". That makes it a mandatory operator step, so the migration family fits. The name v1-migration-upgrade-procedure is the kebab-case form of the evidence's own wording, and migration-required is the only change type the migration family uses. The manifest migration to v1 in the same excerpt is part of that procedure, so it does not make this subject wrong.
